reason: The first defect is the unqualified prior-use claim in the note at lines 28–30: it says the existing Type B local account counts the two non-h incidences of a cubic fan neighbour by window/non-window destination. The manuscript's B1 profile defines those incidences and support types for cubic-closed neighbours, whose two non-h incidences have been assigned to the fan envelope; IsCubicClosed in Lean likewise requires both other neighbours in the envelope. The [144a] handoff plus high-centre normal form makes each assigned first neighbour cubic, but does not make each cubic-closed. Thus the earlier count cannot be claimed for every first neighbour under review. The note's new finite internal/external incidence inventory and explicit zero-outside case are otherwise consistent with the cited handoff, but the source comparison needs the cubic-closed qualifier before acceptance.
